Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses a repeated-measures design where the same individuals serve as their own controls (baseline vs treatment). Levothyroxine is a hormone replacement/supplement, and while it acts as a ligand, it is administered as a drug treatment to induce an experimental state of thyrotoxicosis. No specific child class for hormone replacement was found in the ontology, so the parent 'chemical or drug treatment' is used.
